audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Shen levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items while the page's own whys say Ornn wins extended trades from 3 and that neither of you can kill the other with items.
audit.why: Packet chart and the already-audited mirror agree on Shen, Skill, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn, Skill, Skill: you take level 1 with the blade, Ornn owns 3 through 5 on his CC chain, and the item stages stalemate into a macro game Shen wins with Stand United.
audit.corrected: All seven rows set as matched full/content pairs with ratings, proposed as one atomic group.

audit.why: Spikes are right: Shen at 1, Ornn 3-5 on the Searing Charge pillar combo, Stand United at 6, tank items after. Call of the Forge God is 140/120/100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page told you what actually stops Shadow Dash: Volcanic Rupture's magma pillar is terrain and Searing Charge only knocks up when Ornn collides with terrain, so the pillar is both his setup and your wall.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture (Q, 800 range, 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s) slows and leaves a pillar; Searing Charge (E, 450 range, 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s) knocks up only on a terrain collision, and that pillar supplies it. Call of the Forge God knocks up and can end your Stand United channel mid-cast.
audit.corrected: Level 3-5 rows rekeyed to the pillar-into-charge combo with real cooldowns, and the channel interrupt tied to his knockups.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Ornn must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: His window now: Searing Charge into a Volcanic Rupture pillar knocks you up. Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, not that combo.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Volcanic Rupture's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Still his: Volcanic Rupture (9s at rank 1) slows you into Bellows Breath Brittle. Short-trade only and hold the wave your side.

edits.before: Stand United makes your lane a 1v2 for the enemy MAP — track every low ally. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ornn's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Stand United makes your lane a 1v2 for the enemy map, but Searing Charge and his ultimate knock you out of the channel — start it out of reach.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Ornn carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two tank builds, no solo kills: eat his R knockup on purpose so your carry walks free, and cash the map lead R already banked.

edits.before: Wall-knockup setup. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Its magma pillar is terrain — it walls off Shadow Dash. Engage after.

notes: Kit-file flag artifact not written to the page: Volcanic Rupture carries a 'grounding' flag, but Riot's text describes a slow plus a magma pillar — I wrote the pillar as terrain (which is in the text) rather than asserting grounding. Left unverified and untouched, as the mirror audit also did: the content strings claiming Bellows Breath grants a shield or makes Ornn unstoppable (whys[2], spikes[1], early, wants.you[0]) — Riot's W text says neither.
